0.0: 2011 is the Year of the Rabbit! At last! What kind of luck do you think you'll have this year? If you want, I can teach you a way to see your future!

yes.0: Hold onto this #b#t3994246##k for #b1 hour#k, and it will turn into a #b#t3994247##k. Bring it to me then, and I'll give you an item that will read your fortune. Just 1 hour, bring the #b#t3994247##k to me, and viola! The future!

1.0: Has it been 1 hour already? Did the clover turn green?

yes.0: Fantastic! Here is a #b#t2028068##k. Open it, and you'll get an item... If you're lucky, it'll be a good item, and you'll know you'll have a lucky year! Isn't that brilliant? Good luck!
